title: Lipid–polymer hybrid-vesicles interrupt nucleation of amyloid fibrillation
content:
RSC Chem. Biol., 2024, 5,1248-1258
DOI: 10.1039/D4CB00217B, Paper
Open Access

Newton Sen, Stephanie Krüger, Wolfgang H. Binder
Hybrid-vesicles composed of amphiphilic polymers in POPC-lipids inhibit Aβ1–40 peptide fibrillation by interfering with primary and secondary nucleation, most pronounced by the cholesteryl-anchored polymers.
